title: Wall St rises on the day but falls for the week; bond yields and Iran in focus

title: Nvidia earnings are on deck next week. These 3 themes will be mission-critical.
title_zh: 英伟达的财报将于下周公布。这三个主题将是至关重要的。
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) is set to report second quarter earnings results on Wednesday, Aug. 26, after markets close. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley discusses his expectations for the earnings print, highlighting what investors will be keeping an eye on.
summary_zh: 英伟达 (NVDA) 将于 8 月 26 日星期三收盘后公布第二季度盈利结果。雅虎财经科技编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 讨论了他对财报的预期，强调了投资者将关注的内容。

title: Anthropic's IPO could come sooner than you think — likely beating OpenAI to the punch
title_zh: Anthropic 的 IPO 可能会比你想象的更早——可能会抢先一步 OpenAI
summary: Anthropic's (ANTH.PVT) IPO paperwork could be filed as soon as this month, potentially beating OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) to the punch.  Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley outlines what we know so far.
summary_zh: Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) 的 IPO 文件最早可能于本月提交，这可能会抢先 OpenAI (OPAI.PVT)。  雅虎财经技术编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 概述了我们迄今为止所了解的情况。

title: Tim Cook built Apple’s $32M-an-hour growth machine: Can John Ternus keep it going?
title_zh: 蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 打造了苹果每小时 3200 万美元的增长机器：约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 能否让它继续运转？
summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi and Tech Editor Dan Howley look back at Tim Cook’s tenure as Apple (AAPL) CEO, a period that saw the company generate roughly $32 million in growth per hour.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经执行主编布莱恩·索齐 (Brian Sozzi) 和技术编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 回顾了蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 作为苹果 (AAPL) 首席执行官的任期，在此期间，该公司每小时实现约 3200 万美元的增长。
